judged_text: The rewrite replaces PostCreator's `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` with TopicEmbed.import_remote, which never passes a timestamp, so every imported Disqus thread is dated at import-run time. Re-imported forums lose their original chronology — topics sort as if they were all created the day of the import — a silent regression of the importer's previously accepted data-fidelity behavior with no human sign-off for changing it.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the importer previously created the topic/post via `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) ...)`, preserving original thread timestamps. The diff replaces that with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` and `TopicEmbed.import` never pass `created_at` into `PostCreator` (they only pass `title`, `raw`, `skip_validations`, `cook_method`), so imported topics/posts will default to the import run time. This is a verifiable behavior change that can break chronology/sorting for imported Disqus data.
